description: This file defines layout constants, a custom panel class, and an enum related to canvas presentation within a macOS application, specifically for the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: CanvasPanel
classes.description: A subclass of NSPanel that overrides properties to allow becoming key and main window.

methods.name: canBecomeKey
methods.description: Overrides NSPanel property to indicate whether the panel can become key.

methods.name: canBecomeMain
methods.description: Overrides NSPanel property to indicate whether the panel can become main.
